QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Shumi, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p403##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p403#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p403# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: I'm only telling you this because it's me. If you walk around with a blank look like that, you're just begging to get ripped off by bad guys, so watch your back. Anyway, did you actually want something from me?
1.1: What? You're a new resident of #m10003000#? The fact that you even thought about living here means you're definitely not average. Heh, I'm really looking forward to seeing what you do!
1.2: I bet you're wondering how a girl like me survives in a city like this. But you'd better not judge me just by my looks. Anyway, let's get along!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
